purpose: Describe how long companies remain evaluable in the accessible pre-endtest panels, without using any signal.
accessOrder: render the report from that JSON artifact
forbiddenInputPolicy: Every other panel basename, encrypted file, or row with accepted date after 2020-12-31 aborts before aggregation.

population.unit: one non-empty CIK with at least one periodic SEC filing in an allowed panel
population.deduplication: Within company and fiscal period, keep the earliest accepted filing; amendments do not add survival time.
population.identityPolicy: CIKs may exist only in process memory. No company identifier or company name may be written to an artifact or report.

timeDefinition.axis: calendar quarter of SEC accepted timestamp
timeDefinition.entry: earliest accepted periodic filing across both allowed panels
timeDefinition.cadenceRule: Any 10-K or 10-Q makes the company quarterly; companies with only 20-F/40-F are annual.
timeDefinition.event: first expected filing date after the last observed periodic filing when that expected date is on or before 2020-12-31
timeDefinition.rightCensoring: If the next expected filing date is after 2020-12-31, censor administratively at 2020-12-31.
timeDefinition.duration: integer calendar-quarter distance from entry quarter to event or censor quarter

testStatistic.primary: discrete Kaplan-Meier survival probability for every integer quarter since entry
secondary: first quarter where survival probability is <= 0.5 (median stay)
number of terminal exits by absolute calendar quarter
testStatistic.effectiveN: number of unique companies; daily points and filings are not independent observations

nullModel: No terminal attrition after panel entry: zero events and survival probability 1.0 at every duration.
threshold: At least one terminal event descriptively rejects the no-attrition null. This is not a significance threshold, decision gate, or product rule.
requiredInvariants: events plus right-censored companies equals effective N
the at-risk set reconciles to zero
survival is monotone non-increasing and remains within [0,1]
exit-quarter counts sum to total events
the output contains no company identifiers, company names, signal fields, daily observations, or post-2020 dates
explicitNonClaims: The curve is not company lifetime; history before 2009 is not observed.
Terminal disappearance is not the same as bankruptcy, delisting, or business failure.
Temporary reporting gaps before the final filing are not modeled.
The calculation does not estimate a causal effect and has no gate behind it.
